=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:422-455 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `is_maintenance_pr` treats any open PR from this repository whose head branch matches `ai/plan-autopilot-<YYYYMMDD>-<sha7>[-2|-3]` as the autopilot's maintenance PR, and nothing checks that the autopilot opened it.
  WHY: Any repository writer can push a branch with a matching name and open a PR. `run_gate` then returns `maintenance_pr_open` with `save_marker=True`, which suppresses every audit and dispatch until that PR closes; once it goes stale, the status report flags the unrelated PR. Both reviewers rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion, not as a defect.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:86 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: MAINTENANCE_BRANCH_RE is unanchored (missing ^ and $).
  WHY: The regex can match anywhere in the string, so a name like `feature/ai/plan-autopilot-20261125-abcdef0` could pass the maintenance-PR check and enable a denial-of-service. The reviewer gave no severity label, so medium is a placeholder. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 states that the branch name "must exactly match the pattern at line 87".
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The audit follows "/audit-plans steps 1-8, including step 4a's refresh"; step 4a (.claude/commands/audit-plans.md line 22) limits the staleness check and refresh to plans classified PARTIAL or NOT IMPLEMENTED.
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-audit.txt, "Step 4a, stale-plan refresh" ("A plan is STALE when ..." / "Refresh every other STALE plan in place ...")
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither prompt file limits the refresh to PARTIAL or NOT_IMPLEMENTED plans; they define staleness for "a plan" and say "Refresh every other STALE plan". No hunk adds the filter. tests/test_plan_audit_prompt_contract.py does not assert this rule. So a stale COMPLETE plan can be edited and then archived, and `check_diff` in scripts/plan_autopilot.py refuses that archive ("archive changed the plan content" / "archive target does not carry the plan content"). The run ends with diff_outside_allowlist and saves no marker, so the 75-minute audit re-runs on every idle tick. All four reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- requirement: In agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md, in the `gate` description after `maintenance_pr_open`, add "(only a same-repository head named exactly `ai/plan-autopilot-<YYYYMMDD>-<sha7>[-2|-3]`; fork PRs are ignored)".
  expected_change_site: agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md, line 2, `gate` description in the "Workflow architecture" block
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The last run changed only scripts/plan_autopilot.py and tests/test_plan_autopilot.py. In the fragment, `maintenance_pr_open` appears only on lines 2 and 5, and the fragment never mentions "fork", "same-repository" or the exact branch format. `is_maintenance_pr` (scripts/plan_autopilot.py:442-455) now enforces that rule, so the docs and the code disagree. This is a documentation gap only; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- requirement: The fix spec (item 3) requires the test to assert `pa.is_maintenance_pr({"head": {"ref": "ai/plan-autopilot-20261120-abcdef0-2", "repo": {"full_name": "O/R"}}}, "o/r") is True` (case-insensitive same-repo match).
  expected_change_site: tests/test_plan_autopilot.py, test_gate_ignores_fork_and_misnamed_maintenance_branches (lines 157-169)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The shipped test only asserts `pa.MAINTENANCE_BRANCH_RE.fullmatch(pa.branch_name(...))` (line 169) and never calls is_maintenance_pr directly. The `.lower()` comparison (scripts/plan_autopilot.py:451-453) is untested, so a regression that drops it would pass. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised this as hardening only.
- requirement: "All tests below pass", including tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py and tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py.
  expected_change_site: The PR body acceptance table and those two test runs on the PR head SHA
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR Acceptance table marks both targets "unmet". The pre-push gate lists them as inherited failures that also fail on the merge-base, but the acceptance criterion is still not shown as met.
- requirement: "A dry-run in this repo with the variable on … produces a status issue with a correct report."
  expected_change_site: Acceptance evidence for an enabled `plan_autopilot` run and its status issue
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The supplied PR validation context contains no enabled autopilot run and no resulting status report; the PR description marks the pre-push gate unverified.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
